notes: Gates ran against the working tree at HEAD de0266d on win32 / Node v24.11.0 / npm 11.6.1 (CI uses Node 20 on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest). The tree had uncommitted modifications to package-lock.json, .claude/settings.json and .codemie/codemie-cli.config.json before and after the run; CI installs with `npm ci` from the committed lockfile, so installed dependencies may differ from what was validated here. Self-skip: "No staged changes to scan" — the script scans only `git diff --staged` and nothing is staged, so the committed branch diff was not scanned. Also chained in .husky/pre-commit. Guide Skip-if names the Docker daemon (docker is not installed here) but the script also accepts Podman, which is running, so it was run; guide says the hook prints a hint and skips without Docker, whereas the script exits 1 unless CODEMIE_SKIP_SECRETS_SCAN=1. To scan locally: stage the changes before running, or run gitleaks over origin/main..HEAD. Still owed: CI job secrets-detection.

gates.command: gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json title -q '.title' | npx commitlint --verbose
gates.notes: CI job validate-commits lints the PR title fetched from the GitHub API; no PR exists for this run. The title must be a Conventional Commit per commitlint.config.cjs.

GitHub Action scanning the PR commits with .gitleaks.toml; the repo defines no local command for it and no gitleaks binary is on PATH. Only CI can settle this check; a local equivalent would be the ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1 image via Podman over origin/main..HEAD.
Release deploy in .github/workflows/publish.yml (release / manual dispatch only); needs NPM_TOKEN and is not a merge check.
